questions.question: A body mentioned in the Constitution of India under any Article is known as a:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
A Constitutional Body is one whose existence and functions are explicitly mentioned in the Constitution under a specific Article, giving it a high degree of independence and authority. These bodies draw their power directly from the Constitution itself

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
एक संवैधानिक निकाय वह होता है जिसका अस्तित्व और कार्य स्पष्ट रूप से संविधान में एक विशिष्ट अनुच्छेद के तहत उल्लिखित होते हैं, जो उसे उच्च स्तर की स्वतंत्रता और अधिकार प्रदान करता है। ये निकाय अपनी शक्ति सीधे संविधान से प्राप्त करते हैं।

questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution deals with the Election Commission of India (ECI)?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Article 324 (Part XV) of the Constitution vests the power of superintendence, direction, and control of elections to Parliament, State Legislatures, and the offices of the President and Vice-President in the Election Commission

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
संविधान का अनुच्छेद 324 (भाग XV) संसद, राज्य विधानमंडलों, और राष्ट्रपति तथा उपराष्ट्रपति के कार्यालयों के चुनावों के अधीक्षण, निर्देशन और नियंत्रण की शक्ति निर्वाचन आयोग में निहित करता है।

questions.question: What is the term of office for the Chairman and members of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)?

options.a: 5 years or until the age of 62 years
options.b: 6 years or until the age of 65 years
options.c: 5 years or until the age of 60 years
options.d: At the pleasure of the President

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The members of the UPSC hold office for a term of six years or until they attain the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier. This fixed term ensures the independence of the body. / UPSC

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
के सदस्य छह वर्ष की अवधि के लिए या 65 वर्ष की आयु प्राप्त करने तक, जो भी पहले हो, पद धारण करते हैं। यह निश्चित कार्यकाल निकाय की स्वतंत्रता सुनिश्चित करता है।

questions.question: The Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG) is mentioned in which Article of the Constitution?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Article 148 provides for an independent office of the CAG, who is the head of the Indian Audit and Accounts Department and the guardian of the public purse

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुच्छेद 148 CAG के एक स्वतंत्र कार्यालय का प्रावधान करता है, जो भारतीय लेखापरीक्षा और लेखा विभाग का प्रमुख और सार्वजनिक धन का संरक्षक होता है।

questions.question: Who is the highest law officer in the country, appointed by the President?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Attorney General (AG) is the highest law officer, appointed under Article 76. He gives advice to the Government of India on legal matters referred to him by the President

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
महान्यायवादी (AG) सर्वोच्च कानून अधिकारी है, जिसे अनुच्छेद 76 के तहत नियुक्त किया जाता है। वह राष्ट्रपति द्वारा सौंपे गए कानूनी मामलों पर भारत सरकार को सलाह देता है।

questions.question: The Finance Commission is constituted by the President every five years and consists of a chairman and how many other members?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Finance Commission, constituted under Article 280, is a quasi-judicial body composed of one Chairman and four other members. They are all appointed by the President

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुच्छेद 280 के तहत गठित वित्त आयोग एक अर्ध-न्यायिक निकाय है जिसमें एक अध्यक्ष और चार अन्य सदस्य होते हैं। इन सभी की नियुक्ति राष्ट्रपति द्वारा की जाती है।

questions.question: Which Constitutional Amendment Act decreased the voting age from 21 to 18 years for Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assembly elections?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The 61st Amendment Act of 1988 is a significant milestone in the history of the Election Commission, as it reduced the voting age to 18 years, thereby increasing the participation of youth in the democratic process. / 61

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
वाँ संशोधन अधिनियम 1988 निर्वाचन आयोग के इतिहास में एक महत्वपूर्ण मील का पत्थर है, क्योंकि इसने मतदान की आयु 18 वर्ष कर दी, जिससे लोकतांत्रिक प्रक्रिया में युवाओं की भागीदारी बढ़ी।

questions.question: What is the maximum age limit for the Chairman and members of a State Public Service Commission (SPSC)?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The members of the SPSC hold office for a term of six years or until they attain the age of 62 years, whichever is earlier. Note that this is different from the UPSC age limit (65 years). / SPSC

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
के सदस्य छह वर्ष की अवधि के लिए या 62 वर्ष की आयु प्राप्त करने तक, जो भी पहले हो, पद धारण करते हैं। ध्यान दें कि यह UPSC की आयु सीमा (65 वर्ष) से अलग है।

questions.question: Who serves as the ex-officio Chairperson of the Goods and Services Tax (GST) Council in India?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The GST Council, inserted by Article 279-A (101st CAA, 2016), is a joint forum of the Centre and State, and its chairperson is the Union Finance Minister

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुच्छेद 279-A (101वां संवैधानिक संशोधन अधिनियम, 2016) द्वारा स्थापित जीएसटी परिषद, केंद्र और राज्य का एक संयुक्त मंच है, और इसके अध्यक्ष केंद्रीय वित्त मंत्री होते हैं।

questions.question: Which body was replaced by the National Institution for Transforming India (NITI AAYOG) in January 2015?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
NITI AAYOG is an Executive Body created by an Executive Resolution to replace the decades-old Planning Commission, shifting from a centrally planned model to a more consultative approach

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
नीति आयोग एक कार्यकारी निकाय है, जिसे दशकों पुराने योजना आयोग को प्रतिस्थापित करने के लिए एक कार्यकारी संकल्प द्वारा स्थापित किया गया, जिससे केंद्रीय नियोजना मॉडल से अधिक परामर्शात्मक दृष्टिकोण की ओर बदलाव हुआ।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) and the State Public Service Commission (SPSC):
1. The members of both UPSC and SPSC are appointed by the President of India.
2. The members of both UPSC and SPSC can be removed only by the President of India.
 Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The members of UPSC are appointed by the President, but the members of SPSC are appointed by the Governor. However, the power to remove the chairman or any member of either UPSC or SPSC lies only with the President. / UPSC

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
के सदस्यों की नियुक्ति राष्ट्रपति द्वारा की जाती है, लेकिन SPSC के सदस्यों की नियुक्ति राज्यपाल द्वारा की जाती है। हालांकि, UPSC या SPSC दोनों में से किसी के भी अध्यक्ष या किसी सदस्य को हटाने की शक्ति केवल राष्ट्रपति के पास होती है।

questions.question:
Assertion (A): The Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) is known as the 'Guardian of Public Purse'.
 Reason (R): The CAG is responsible for compiling and maintaining the accounts of both the Central Government and the State Governments.

options.a: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.b: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
options.c: A is true, but R is false.
options.d: A is false, but R is true.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The CAG is indeed the 'Guardian of Public Purse' (A is true). However, the CAG compiles and maintains the accounts of the State Governments only, not the Central Government (R is false). / CAG

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
वास्तव में 'सार्वजनिक धन का संरक्षक' है (A सत्य है)। हालाँकि, CAG केवल राज्य सरकारों के खातों का संकलन और रखरखाव करता है, न कि केंद्र सरकार का (R असत्य है)।

questions.question: Which of the following constitutional bodies were separated by the 89th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2003?

options.a: National Commission for SC's and National Commission for BC's
options.b: National Commission for SC's and National Commission for ST's

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The 89th CAA, 2003, separated the combined National Commission for SCs and STs into two distinct bodies: the National Commission for SCs (Art 338) and the National Commission for STs (Art 338A). / 89

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
वें संवैधानिक संशोधन अधिनियम, 2003 ने संयुक्त राष्ट्रीय अनुसूचित जाति और जनजाति आयोग को दो अलग-अलग निकायों में विभाजित कर दिया: राष्ट्रीय अनुसूचित जाति आयोग (अनुच्छेद 338) और राष्ट्रीय अनुसूचित जनजाति आयोग (अनुच्छेद 338A)।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the Election Commission of India (ECI):
1. The ECI is not concerned with the election of Panchayats and Municipalities.
2. The term of the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) is 6 years or until the age of 65 years.
 Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The ECI is responsible for elections to the Parliament and State Legislatures, but not Panchayats and Municipalities, which fall under the State Election Commission (Statement 1 is correct). The term for CEC and other Election Commissioners is 6 years or 65 years, whichever is earlier (Statement 2 is correct). / ECI

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
संसद और राज्य विधानमंडलों के चुनावों के लिए जिम्मेदार है, लेकिन पंचायतों और नगरपालिकाओं के लिए नहीं, जो राज्य चुनाव आयोग के अंतर्गत आते हैं (कथन 1 सही है)। CEC और अन्य चुनाव आयुक्तों का कार्यकाल 6 वर्ष या 65 वर्ष, जो भी पहले हो, होता है (कथन 2 सही है)।

questions.question: Which of the following bodies was initially set up by an Executive Resolution but later conferred a Statutory Status in 2003?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The CVC was set up in 1964 by an Executive Resolution based on the recommendations of the Santhanam Committee. It was later conferred Statutory Status in 2003 by an Act of Parliament

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
केंद्रीय सतर्कता आयोग (CVC) की स्थापना 1964 में संथानम समिति की सिफारिशों के आधार पर एक कार्यकारी संकल्प द्वारा की गई थी। बाद में संसद के एक अधिनियम द्वारा 2003 में इसे सांविधिक दर्जा प्रदान किया गया।

questions.question: The National Commission for Backward Classes (NCBC) was conferred constitutional status by which amendment act?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The NCBC was initially a statutory body established in 1993. The 102nd Amendment Act of 2018 conferred constitutional status on it by inserting Article 338B in the Constitution

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
राष्ट्रीय पिछड़ा वर्ग आयोग (NCBC) शुरू में 1993 में स्थापित एक सांविधिक निकाय था। 102वें संशोधन अधिनियम, 2018 ने संविधान में अनुच्छेद 338B जोड़कर इसे संवैधानिक दर्जा प्रदान किया।

questions.question:
Which of the following statements regarding the electoral rolls is/are correct?
 1. There is one general electoral roll for every territorial constituency.
 2. No person is ineligible for inclusion in the electoral roll on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex, or any of them.
 3. A citizen of India, not less than 18 years of age, can cast his/her vote unless disqualified under a law of an appropriate legislature.
 Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
There is one general electoral roll for every territorial constituency. No person is ineligible for inclusion in the electoral roll-on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex, or any of them. A citizen of India, not less than 18 years of age, can cast his/her vote unless disqualified under a law of an appropriate legislature.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements about the Inter-State Council is/are correct?
 1. It can inquire into disputes between States.
 2. It cannot investigate subjects involving the Union.
 Select the correct answer using the code given below.
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Inter-State Council is empowered to "investigate and discuss subjects in which some or all of the States, or the Union and one or more of the States, have a common interest". Therefore, it can investigate subjects involving the Union.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements about the National Commission for Women are correct ?
 1. It is a statutory body.
 2. It has the mandate to review the constitutional and legal safeguards for women.
 3. It has the mandate to advise the Government on all policy matters affecting women.
 Select the answer using the code given below:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The National Commission for Women (NCW) is an important institution in India aimed at protecting and promoting women's rights.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements with regard to recommendations of the 15th Finance Commission of India are correct?
 1. It has recommended grants of ₹4,800 crores from the year 2022–23 to the year 2025–26 for incentivizing States to enhance educational outcomes.
 2. 45% of the net proceeds of Union taxes are to be shared with States.
 3. ₹45,000 crores are to be kept as performance-based incentive for all States for carrying out agricultural reforms.
 4. It reintroduced tax effort criteria to reward fiscal performance.
 Select the correct answer using the code given below.
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The 15th FC recommended that the States' share in the Union taxes be 41% (a 1% reduction from the 14th FC's 42% to accommodate the newly formed Union Territories of J&K and Ladakh).

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
15वें वित्त आयोग ने सिफारिश की थी कि संघीय करों में राज्यों का हिस्सा 41% होना चाहिए (नवगठित केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों जम्मू-कश्मीर और लद्दाख को समायोजित करने के लिए 14वें वित्त आयोग के 42% से 1% की कटौती)।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Central Vigilance Commission (CVC):
 1. Central Vigilance Commissioner is appointed by the President of India.
 2. The Committee to recommend the appointment of Central Vigilance Commissioner has the Minister of Home Affairs as one of the members.
 3. In certain circumstances the Leader of the single largest group in opposition in Lok Sabha can be on the Committee to recommend the appointment of Central Vigilance Commissioner.

questions.question:

 1. He audits and reports on all expenditures from the Consolidated Fund of India.
 2. He controls the issue and receipt of money from the Consolidated Fund of India.

 Which of the statements given above are correct?

questions.question:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities was conferred a Constitutional status by the 7th CAA, 1956, and a new Article 350B was inserted.
2. The Advocate General of the State can be removed by the Governor at any time, as his term is not fixed by the Constitution.
 Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Both statements are correct. The 7th CAA, 1956, inserted Article 350B, giving constitutional status to the Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities (Statement 1). The Advocate General (Art 165) holds office during the pleasure of the Governor and can be removed by the Governor at any time (Statement 2)

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
दोनों कथन सही हैं। 7वें संवैधानिक संशोधन अधिनियम, 1956 ने अनुच्छेद 350B डाला, जिससे भाषाई अल्पसंख्यकों के लिए विशेष अधिकारी को संवैधानिक दर्जा मिला (कथन 1)। महाधिवक्ता (अनुच्छेद 165) राज्यपाल के प्रसादपर्यंत पद धारण करता है और राज्यपाल द्वारा किसी भी समय हटाया जा सकता है (कथन 2)।
